resolved_investigations.next_action: Fixed (bcpf). Shared cause recorded as observation unit-count-rescaled-by-issuer-normaliser: the same normaliser is seen on 10 funds.

observations.what: Every BCRED maturity is read from the printed page (maturity_date_source 'ixbrl_field_status': 22,361 rows, all with a valid full YYYY-MM-DD date) and every one publishes maturity_precision 'unknown' and maturity_status 'unresolved'. Mechanism: the financial step (pipeline/financial_conventions.py, precision_value) gives day precision only to maturity_date_source 'xbrl_field', 'nport' or 'printed_page', or to a parseable maturity_raw; the page reader's label 'ixbrl_field_status' and the member-text label 'identifier_text' are in neither list and those rows carry no maturity_raw. The reviewer measured about 278,000 such rows on 127 funds in the cohort build. Ruling D-209: the 6 maturity_precision row corrections of round two are reverted (they made 6 rows unlike the fund's other 22,361); the correctable field and its tests stay. Not fixed cohort-wide. The same gap covers maturities read from the member text (maturity_date_source 'identifier_text', about 10,410 rows on 45 funds per the bcpf review; BCRED has none): that label is not in the precision list either.
observations.suggested_check: A coverage metric, not a row finding: per fund, quarter and maturity_date_source (ixbrl_field_status, identifier_text, or any other), the share of rows with a valid full maturity date whose precision is 'unknown'; alert when a source's share is above zero, so one entry per source names the gap instead of flagging 278k rows.

detection_decision.rationale: A per-row check would flag every page-read maturity in the cohort; grouped by source it reports one mechanism per source and goes to zero when the precision list is fixed.
